findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic hash functions
 * @description Detects use of MD5 or SHA1 from hashlib
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-hash-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of weak hash function (MD5/SHA1) which is considered cryptographically broken."
findings.hypothesis: Package uses weak cryptographic hash algorithms MD5/SHA1

message.text: Use of weak hash function (MD5/SHA1) which is considered cryptographically broken.
Use of weak hash function (MD5/SHA1) which is considered cryptographically broken.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic hash in tools
 * @description Detect use of MD5/SHA1 in the tools/ helper scripts, which may be insecure for security-sensitive contexts.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-hash-tools
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("tools/%")
select call, "Use of weak hash function (MD5/SHA1) in tools script."
findings.hypothesis: Use of weak hashes (MD5/SHA1) in tooling, which might be copied into production code.

message.text: Use of weak hash function (MD5/SHA1) in tools script.
Use of weak hash function (MD5/SHA1) in tools script.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential unsafe usage of socket in tools
 * @description Find direct socket usage in tools directory which may lack TLS or proper validation.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/socket-tools-usage
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-319
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember(["socket", "create_connection"]).getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("tools/%")
select call, "Direct socket usage in tools script; ensure TLS and proper validation are used."
findings.hypothesis: Tool scripts might use raw sockets without TLS, risking cleartext transmission.

message.text: Direct socket usage in tools script; ensure TLS and proper validation are used.
